```{r}
library(patchwork)

p_region <- visnights %>% 
  group_by(Month, Region) %>%
  summarise(Nights = sum(Nights), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(year(Month) > 2015) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = Nights, color = Region)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
    guides(color = "none") +
    labs(
        subtitle = "77 Regions",
        title = "Australian Domestic Tourism Monthly Flows in 77 Regions, summing up to 7 States, 
and up to Total Australia"
    ) +
    scale_x_yearmonth(
      breaks = yearmonth(c("2017 Jan", "2019 Jan")),   # two yearmonth objects
      labels = c("Jan 2017", "Jan 2019")                # custom text
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 55000),           # lower limit 0, upper auto
      expand = c(0, 0)             # remove padding at axes
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)  # center the title
    )

p_state <- visnights %>% 
  group_by(Month, State) %>%
  summarise(Nights = sum(Nights), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(year(Month) > 2015) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = Nights, color = State)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 1) +
    guides(color = "none") +
    labs(
        subtitle = "7 States"
    ) +
    scale_x_yearmonth(
      breaks = yearmonth(c("2017 Jan", "2019 Jan")),   # two yearmonth objects
      labels = c("Jan 2017", "Jan 2019")                # custom text
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 55000),           # lower limit 0, upper auto
      expand = c(0, 0)             # remove padding at axes
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)  # center the title
    )

p_aus <- visnights %>% 
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Nights = sum(Nights), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(year(Month) > 2015) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = Nights)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 1, color = "red") +
    guides(color = "none") +
    labs(
      subtitle = "Australia",
      caption = "Source: Tourism Research Australia"
    ) +
    scale_x_yearmonth(
      breaks = yearmonth(c("2017 Jan", "2019 Jan")),   # two yearmonth objects
      labels = c("Jan 2017", "Jan 2019")                # custom text
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 55000),           # lower limit 0, upper auto
      expand = c(0, 0)             # remove padding at axes
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)  # center the title
    )

p_region + p_state + p_aus + 
    plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect", axes = "collect") & 
    labs(
        y = "Visitor Nights (Thousands)"
    )
```
